Book correction: The answer key (book page 296) prints Range f^{-1} = (-3,\ \infty) for Q3 (ii). The range of f^{-1} is the domain of f, which is x < -3; so the correct range is (-\infty,\ -3). The printed f^{-1}(x) and domain are right.

Book correction: The answer key (book page 296) prints, for Q3 (iii), the root as \sqrt{2\ -3 + x} without brackets and Domain f^{-1} = [-3,\ \infty). Correct: f^{-1}(x) = \dfrac{4 + \sqrt{2(x - 3)}}{2} and Domain f^{-1} = [3,\ \infty) (the range of f = 2(x - 2)^2 + 3 on x \ge 2). The range [2,\ \infty) is right.

Book correction: The answer key (book page 296) prints Range f^{-1} = (-\infty,\ -4] for Q3 (vi). The domain of f is x < -4 (strict), so -4 is not an output of f^{-1}: the correct range is (-\infty,\ -4).
